notes: Prompts name the Picard command a user would name. None mentions turbo-picard. Each sandbox has turbo-picard, upstream Picard 3.4.0, Java and samtools on PATH.

tasks.prompt: Our pipeline's Picard MarkDuplicates step keeps getting killed with java.lang.OutOfMemoryError on the 8 GB nodes we're stuck with. Please mark duplicates in data/sample.bam and write out/marked.bam plus the duplication metrics at out/marked.metrics.txt. Downstream GATK steps and our QC dashboards expect Picard's duplicate flags and metrics, so don't change those semantics.
Coordinate-sort data/unsorted.bam with SortSam and write the result to out/sorted.bam. We run this for hundreds of samples, so it should be as quick as you can make it.

Run CollectHsMetrics on data/sample.bam using data/baits.interval_list as the bait intervals and data/targets.interval_list as the targets, with reference data/ref.fa. Write the hybrid-selection metrics to out/hs_metrics.txt.

workflow/main.nf's MARK_DUPLICATES process is the slowest and most memory-hungry step in our Nextflow pipeline (it needs 16 GB). Edit the process to cut runtime and memory, but the BAM and metrics outputs must stay Picard-identical and keep the same filenames. Nextflow isn't installed here, but the tools the process calls are on PATH, so you can try the command directly on data/sample.bam (write any test outputs under out/).
Generate Picard CollectAlignmentSummaryMetrics for data/sample.bam against reference data/ref.fa and save them to out/aln_metrics.txt for MultiQC.
I need CollectInsertSizeMetrics for data/sample.bam: metrics in out/insert_size_metrics.txt and the histogram at out/insert_size_histogram.pdf.
Use BuildBamIndex to index data/sample.bam, writing the index to out/sample.bai.
Convert data/sample.bam back to paired FASTQ the way Picard SamToFastq does: read 1 to out/r1.fastq and read 2 to out/r2.fastq.
GATK is rejecting data/sample.bam because of its read groups. Run AddOrReplaceReadGroups with RGID=grp2 RGLB=libA RGPL=ILLUMINA RGPU=unit1 RGSM=patient7 and write out/rg.bam.
Estimate library complexity for data/sample.bam with Picard's EstimateLibraryComplexity and write the metrics to out/elc_metrics.txt.
